entities.summary: Rodrigo Augusto Pastore is an Argentine basketball coach and former player. He currently serves as head coach for Niners Chemnitz which plays in Basketball Bundesliga (BBL). Born in Buenos Aires, he played in Germany, Italy and Switzerland.
